result:
I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is untested.

- **Page:** a 1280px `#component` on white, with a centered column (max 1120px, 48px above, 32px side padding). The "Requests" heading is Unbounded Light in capitals at the page-title size.
- **Message:** "No requests yet" is Unbounded Medium in mixed case. The line below it is muted body text. Both are centered.
- **Actions:** "Create a Request" is a 44px ink pill, the one primary button on the screen. "Import from a spreadsheet" is a plain underlined link in the accent text colour.
- **Tokens:** I copied only the tokens the page uses from `tokens.css` into the file, with the dusk-theme values for them. All colours, sizes and spacing come from those tokens.

- **Primary button placement:** DESIGN.md puts the screen's primary action in the top row on the right. I put "Create a Request" in the centered message instead, because DESIGN.md allows only one primary button per screen and your content places it with the message.
- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't in the folder and the brief rules out other assets. They fall back to the system font unless they're installed locally.
